BiblicalUsage: margêʻâh is rest, and it occurs once, in Isaiah 28:12. There the LORD says this is the rest with which you may cause the weary to rest, and this is the refreshing, yet they would not hear. The word is the rest that was offered and refused.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe margêʻâh shows me that God offers rest to the weary, and that refusing it is the surest way to lose it.
